verdict.rationale: Deel documents a REST API, OAuth2 app authorization, webhooks and an MCP server that exposes payroll data. None of the evidence describes a white-label or embedded payroll offering, or a partner program that lets developers run payroll inside their own branded product. The API and OAuth access are integration building blocks rather than the embedded white-label capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed white-label payroll into my own product through a partner API
